data.title: Office Operations & Sales Executive - Fintech
data.details:
Futurefund Financial is hiring for Office Operations & Sales Executive-Warje Location(Local Candidate preferred only)

About the Company

Futurefund Financial operates in banking, finance, NBFC, financial services and B2C sales. The organization is seeking an Office Operations & Sales Executive to support dependable office administration, loan processing and coordinated sales activity. This is a full-time, work-from-office role based in Pune, with a Monday-to-Saturday schedule. The annual salary range for this position is ₹3,00,000–₹3,20,000.

Responsibilities

  • Manage daily office operations and administrative tasks, keeping records, reports and documentation organized and up to date.
  • Coordinate effectively across departments and assist with the timely flow of operational information.
  • Process customer documentation and applications, coordinating with banks, financial institutions and internal teams.
  • Track loan applications, pending cases and disbursement progress, following up to support timely completion.
  • Work closely with sales colleagues on daily business activity, lead tracking, customer follow-ups and application progress.
  • Prepare daily MIS and performance reports, and provide practical coordination support toward business targets.

Requirements

  • At least 1 year of relevant professional experience in office operations, administration, backend processing, sales coordination or a related area.
  • Ability to maintain accurate records and handle customer documents and applications with care.
  • Strong coordination and follow-up skills for working with customers, sales teams, banks and internal stakeholders.
  • Comfort with monitoring case progress, preparing routine MIS reports and managing multiple operational tasks.
  • Willingness to work from the Pune office Monday through Saturday.

data.title: Sales Executive
data.details:
Sales Executive

Company: Naaz AI Labs
Location: Bengaluru, Karnataka
Job Type: Full-Time

About Naaz AI Labs:

Are you a confident communicator with a passion for sales and a drive to achieve targets? Do you enjoy connecting with people, building relationships, and turning conversations into business opportunities? Naaz AI Labs is looking for enthusiastic and target-driven Sales Executives to join our growing team!

As a Sales Executive, you will play an important role in generating leads, connecting with potential clients, promoting our services, and converting prospects into paying customers.

Our services include AI Automation, Website Development, CRM Systems, Workflow Consulting, and Digital Marketing Solutions.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Identify potential customers and generate new business leads.
  • Make outbound calls to connect with prospective clients.
  • Pitch and promote company services to businesses.
  • Understand client requirements and recommend suitable solutions.
  • Schedule meetings and conduct sales follow-ups.
  • Convert qualified leads into successful sales.
  • Build and maintain strong client relationships.
  • Maintain daily call reports, lead records, and sales updates.
  • Achieve daily, weekly, and monthly sales targets.

Requirements:

  • Good communication and convincing skills.
  • Confidence in making calls and interacting with clients.
  • Strong negotiation and sales skills.
  • Interest in technology, AI, and business solutions.
  • Ability to work in a target-oriented environment.
  • Freshers are welcome to apply.
  • Previous sales experience will be an added advantage.

What We Offer:

  • Career growth and professional development.
  • Hands-on experience in selling AI and digital business solutions.
  • Supportive and growth-oriented team environment.
  • Performance-based incentives, where applicable.
  • Opportunity to develop professional sales and negotiation skills.

Application Process:

Interested candidates can apply by submitting their applications through the application link provided on this page. Shortlisted candidates will be contacted by the Naaz AI Labs team regarding the next steps in the selection process.

Join Naaz AI Labs!

Build your career in sales and become part of a growing team working with AI-powered business solutions. If you are confident, ambitious, and passionate about achieving targets, we would love to hear from you.

Apply now and grow with Naaz AI Labs!
